0.Text: Your activities, <Player>, are far from being inspiring. You are prohibited from conducting any commercial dealings on our planet.

1.Text: What brings you here, Mr. <Player>? I don't believe you're registered as an agent with us.

Text: You know, <Player>, we're not too fond of pirates. It's common knowledge that our race doesn't approve of piracy and smuggling. How can anyone be involved in such dirty business when there is a war with the dominators going on?!!
Shame on you, Mr. <Player>, shame on you!
Oops! ...I did it again. I fleeced a trader...

Oh, hey, <Player>, want to sing a duet with me? It's my jam! Always brings a tear to my eye. Pay no mind, <Player> -- we've orders from the top to learn pirate folk music, seeing as they're calling the shots now. And their slang, obviously. Here, listen: yo, yo, yo, whatcha lookin' at, homes? What, you gonna cry, dingleberry? Gimme your money before I cut you!

Well, what do you think? Still needs work, I know, but I'm making progress! Got any tips? No? You don't have to share if you don't want to, I won't get mad. I've got over 20 pages here to study anyway.

101.Text: <Player>, welcome to the best pirate planet in the entire Galaxy! Sure, there are rumors saying the opposite, but those are all dirty lies spread by haters and the competition. We've got the best entertainment for any taste, no matter how filthy or perverted! There are hundreds of illegal transactions conducted every day, our uniforms have got the most stripes, and our murder rate is so high that a dedicated truck brigade must sweep the streets every morning, picking up bodies. And don't even ask me what they do with the bodies afterwards -- save your appetite. Let's talk about business instead.

102.Text: You're a rotten scoundrel, <Player>, and you're not welcome here. In the old days I would have stuck you into a penal ranger battalion and sent you off to fight dominators. What are you doing here anyway when those blasted tin cans are still polluting our skies?

103.Text: Rather than waste my time player, <Player>, why don't you make yourself useful by wresting a few star systems from dominator control? Where there's no Coalition, we're forced to deal with those stupid tin cans ourselves.

104.Text: Heh, <Player>, I can hardly believe that the Coalition is no more. Unfortunately, I can't say the same about the dominators. To say that those stupid tin cans are a nuisance is to gravely understate the matter. If you're not doing anything at the moment, start aiding the extermination efforts immediately!

105.Text: Hey there, <Player>, my friend! Check out the irony: the Coalition is no more, but their dominator offspring are still here, and they're a major pain in the butt. Something must be done about them before they take over the entire Galaxy.

106.Text: What do you want, <Player>? You may be a pirate, but we can clearly see your rotten ranger essence. So if you've got something to say, say it and make yourself scarce!

107.Text: Looking at you, <Player>, one might think you're a normal, capable pirate. But then there's something else underneath, something... rotten. I don't know what it is, but I just don't trust you, <Player>.

108.Text: It's incredible, <Player>, but no less true! All our enemies are defeated! The Coalition and the dominators have been reduced to a page in history, one that we can easily tear out and chuck into open space. And no one will complain, 'cause there's no one left to complain!

Text: The Galaxy is now in pirate hands, <Player>, and your contribution to our victory was very significant! Toasts are being raised to your health in bars all across the Galaxy, and we're planning on erecting a monument on your home planet. So now there will be two of you: the original gangsta and his 15-foot-tall bronze copy!
Why not gold, you ask? Because we're pirates -- all the gold is already long gone!

Well, well, well, <Player>. When exactly do you intend to cease your unlawful activities? You are an outsider and a pirate to boot, and you have the nerve to waltz in here like it's your home! Now, we haven't had any problems with you yet, but our patience is running thin.
Why don't you buy some equipment from us instead? Nobody seems to want it... :-(
Howdy, <Player>. Did you know that pirates have been clashing with dominators lately? You didn't?! What backwater arm of the Galaxy are you from? Or is this a bad joke?

Never mind, it doesn't matter. The point is the robots are a real problem, and I even heard that the pirate leader has announced that whoever kills the dominator boss will be made his personal consigliere. And their former rank won't even come into play, be they a deadly cutthroat or a clueless noob. 'Course, I can hardly imagine a noob putting even a dent into a dominator ship... You, on the other hand, have probably got a real shot.
Then again, it could all be just rumors...
You free pirates are a lucky bunch, <Player>. What I wouldn't give to rush into battle against the dominators right now, but instead I'm forced to waste away in this cramped office.

When you put down the main robot in charge, be sure to bring me a piece of his skin as a souvenir. I'll be much obliged. In the meantime, let's drink to the pirate clan's imminent and final victory over all our enemies.
Oh, hey, <Player>. Pay no mind to my foul mood. It's this nightmare I had last night, in which the dominators attacked our star system and took it over.

At the risk of sounding subversive, I have to say that things were better back when the Coalition was around. They fought the robots, while we skimmed the cream and rolled around in dough like pigs in mud. But now the Coalition is no more, and the dominators are plowing through our pirate systems. And who's there to defend them? Pirates ain't proper warriors -- they're cowards who are only good for shaking down transport vessels...
Aye, brave bros like you are our only hope, <Player>.

Oh, <Player>, since you're here, would you care to tell me if you pirates are done screwing around with the dominators? It's high time you got your act together and kicked them out of our arm of the Galaxy!

We handled the Coalition just fine, so why can't we handle those tin cans? I'm of a mind to jump into a ship myself and start knocking sense into them. Or into you, 'cause it's getting ridiculous already. We're losing tons of money in this war. And our planet's economy is backwards as it is.
Ugh, just forget it. What did you want?

<Player>, not even in my wildest nightmares could I have imagined our star system being attacked by pirates and dominators simultaneously! Sure, they may be killing each other off, but our defenses are taking tremendous losses as well!
Do something, <Player>, before we're all dead meat! Don't just stand there thinking, run to the hangar! You'll figure out a plan of action on the go.

My dear <Player>, when dominators and pirates invade your system at the same time, notions like combat skill and tactics go out the window! Heck, we can't even coordinate our defenses properly. Fly out to the orbit and see for yourself -- it's a slaughterhouse out there!
You are our only hope, <Player>! Only you with your iron fist can restore order on the battlefield, strike terror into our enemies and inspire our allies!

Ranger, it's all over! Everything we've labored for is about to be destroyed in a vicious battle that's being waged on our orbit! And it's to be expected, with the forces of the Coalition, dominators and pirates all fighting at once! We're receiving reports that our pilots are so disoriented they don't even know who to shoot at!

<Player>, help us! You're our only hope! If you don't get back to the orbit and lead the opposition right away, we will lose this star system faster than a penchecrakus could dig a hole in the sand to stick his head in!

12.Text: And what exactly brings a filthy four-handed peleng like <Player> to our prospering planet? Surely you are here to steal something?

13.Text:
, don't you know that your race is dying out? And that soon maloqs will be ruling the entire Galaxy, and you will all serve us?
Ha! Relax, boy! This is just modern maloq humor. You dimwitted aliens can't even appreciate a joke. Ha-ha!
Oh, by the way, our food prices are pretty low. I strongly suggest that you stock up, 'cause this here's the best agricultural planet in this sector!

14.Text:
Eminent Ranger ! We are glad to see you on the planet of . Don't forget to visit our stores -- you will certainly find something after your fancy!
We also humbly request that you join in the efforts liberating the system from dominator presence. We would be much obliged.

15.Text: The <ToStar> system was invaded by dominators. Help our brothers who live there. We beg you, <Player>. We know that you're not the toughest ranger, but we need everybody's help.

Text: As we speak, vicious and bloody battles against the dominators are unfolding in the <ToStar> system. And you, <Player>, are in a position to help your race big time!

One, you can fly over there and take part in the fighting. And two, you can take with you a batch of meds, which you can buy right here, on our planet. As you can see, we care not only about our interests, but others' as well!

17.Text: <Player>, why are you here and not in the <ToStar> system? That system was recently taken over by dominators! As we speak, the Galaxy's finest rangers are striving to liberate it. After all, planet <ToPlanet> is home to our compatriots! You can't possibly ignore their need!

18.Text:
We are glad to see you, , here on planet .
These are hard times for all of us. Dominators have recently invaded the system. A futile attempt! The Coalition Forces will crush them, don't you agree, ?

Text: Hey, <Player>. Welcome to our lovely maloq planet <CurPlanet>. Now if we could only figure out why you insist on conducting trade and disgracing your name?
If you ask us, you should spend more time eating and beating on your enemies. Be a man, <Player>, quit going to our trade center and we'll respect you more!

2.Text: It's an honor to see you here, <Player>!

Text: A ranger like you is always welcome on planet <CurPlanet>, <Player>. We sympathize with any creature so woefully deprived of extremities, but we hope that this fact doesn't prevent you from running contraband!
Speaking of which, we have a batch of high quality narcotics for sale at a good price. You can take the goods to faeyans or gaals. Both races go crazy for this stuff.

21.Text:
A ranger like you is always welcome on planet , . Are you by any chance interested in selling our arms supplies? Of course you are!
After all, today our weapons containers can be had for as low as cr! Not bad, eh?

22.Text: Hail, four-handed <Player>! What business does a representative of your wretched race have on our planet? All you pelengs are good for is laying ambushes and running contraband.

23.Text:
Hello, , how are things?
We can offer you a large batch of tech on the cheap. Do you feel like making a buck? One container is worth a mere cr. We currently have units in storage. Our neighbors wish they had our selection.

24.Text: Unfortunately, <Player>, your race isn't known for its intellectual prowess. But even you should be able to understand that a container of technical equipment worth a mere <CurPlanetGoodsSale> cr is quite a bargain. Drop by our trade center and buy yourself a batch. Perhaps doing something smart will actually make you smarter.

25.Text:
Our race these days is full of dope fiends...
And it is you foreigners who are responsible for our gradual dying out! Though we're always trying to fight drug pushers, nothing seems to help. The prices are always on the rise, reaching as high as cr per standard unit. We're warning you, , if you bring that junk on our planet, you will make sworn enemies out of us!

Text: Hey, <Player>. I wonder why is it that other races like our art so much? Art is nonsense, strength is everything! But all you seem to be interested in are our stools... How about I take this stool and smash your alien head with it!
The prices are crazy high at <CurPlanetGoodsSale> cr per ton. Our trees are being exported in the form of luxury goods... We don't want our stools exported. Got it?

Hey, <Player>. It's no secret that our planet is run by a dictator. Our economy is in the toilet. Prices are unstable. The environment is in crisis. Our people are starving and are in dire need of food and medical supplies.
If at all possible, please help us by delivering a shipment of food to planet <CurPlanet>.

It's always good to see you, .
As of today the cost of technical equipment equals cr per unit. This price is super low and has been set by our monarch!

We reckon that such low prices will draw more visitors to our planet, especially considering the number of backward planets in our sector willing to pay good money for technology. For instance, you can go to planet <ToPlanet> (<ToStar> system) and unload the goods purchased from us at <ToPlanetGoodsBuy> cr! Think of the possibilities!

29.Text: Dear <Player>! Our prospering planet currently holding a sale on luxury items! Magical maloq stools, human designer handbags and other works of art for only <CurPlanetGoodsSale> cr per ton! Hurry over to the trade center.

3.Text: Always glad to see you, <Player>. Would you like some coffee or a secret mission?

Text:
It is an honor to see you here, !
In case you didn't know, our planet is currently experiencing an acute shortage of production ore. If you want to earn an easy buck, deliver a shipment of minerals here to planet .
Do you have a gripper? Then you can blast an asteroid and collect all its valuable rock. We will pay <CurPlanetGoodsBuy> cr for every ton! Not bad, eh?

Greetings, !
We want to inform you that the industrial sector on the neighboring cattle-breeding planet is still in early stages of development. As such, prices on ore are beyond laughable. We, on the other hand, are in dire need of it.
So if you're looking to make some cash, this would be a quick and totally legit way to do it. But do hurry before another, more resourceful trader beats you to it.
Greetings, <Player>! Did you know that the turmoil on planet <ToPlanet>, a product of a hopelessly incompetent government, has resulted in a sharp drop of prices on spirits?

In contrast, on our planet this type of merchandise has been traditionally in high demand. I bet we would pay good money for it. And you, <Player>, are the exclusive owner of this information! But you must hurry if you want your profit, for there are always resourceful traders looking to make a quick buck.

Greetings, <Player>! You're a fine ranger, aren't you? Well, for some reason the good folks at the ranger center disagree, judging by the low rating they routinely give you. Now why is that? And here is a message from planet <ToPlanet>, whose authorities have put you on their most wanted list. What did you do to piss them off?
You really ought to simmer down and channel your energy in a more productive way, such as unleashing it against the dominators.
Greetings, our glorious compatriot, Ranger <Player>! We know that you are a good ranger and we are proud of you.

But then there's this note that came in from the <ToStar> system; apparently, you're a wanted criminal in their neck of the woods. We've tried defending you as best we could, but they wouldn't have none of it. Their race sure has a very narrow understanding of the law. We recommend that you abstain from flying there, 'cause they will likely arrest you and throw you in the slammer.
Greetings, Ranger <Player>! Our neighbors from planet <ToPlanet> are demanding your immediate extradition. In contrast, we believe that you are not such a bad ranger, so we denied their request.
But keep in mind that they will be looking for you on their orbit! Be on your guard and get yourself a good weapon!

36.Text: Welcome to our wonderful planet <CurPlanet>, human. We must note that you really ought to lead a more active lifestyle. Your rating among rangers is still very low.

Text: We pelengs are always glad to see renowned warriors on our planet. What do you say to smuggling some goods to planets of other races?
If you ask us, it's all legal!

38.Text:
While you're sitting pretty planetside, others are battling dominators on the orbit! For shame, !!
I swear, these rangers are so clueless...

Text: A coup is gearing up on planet <ToPlanet>, home to our compatriots. The prices for arms are sky high.

How about you deliver a shipment of weapons to the system, specifically units at a price of cr?
If you're interested in our offer, please make your way to the trade center. Profit is guaranteed.

4.Text: What the hell are you doing on our planet, outlander <Player>? You are not welcome here.

Text: A cultural revolution on a civilized planet like ours has led to total harmony. We have long been exporting all manner of artwork. Today you can purchase luxury goods from us at a mere <CurPlanetGoodsSale> cr per standard unit.

Perhaps you're interested in legal trade, <Player>? In that case, we propose you transport a shipment of cargo to planet <ToPlanet> in the <ToStar> system. The local monarchy pays top dollar for these goods.

Dear <Player>! We're happy to welcome you to our planet. We sincerely hope that you have no interest in controlled substances, and that your activities here, whatever they may be, will not breach any laws.

But if you happen to be an addict, you should head to planet <ToPlanet> in the <ToStar> system. There you'll be allowed to legally procure whatever you need for only <ToPlanetGoodsSale> cr per standard unit.

42.Text: Ranger <Player>, your reputation on our planet and with our race in general leaves much to be desired. That is why, as a government representative, I must inform you that you are prohibited from conducting any business dealings on our planet.

Text: How's the situation in space, <Player>? What is the purpose of your visit? Do you have any illegal goods on board? Answer at once!
Then again, you really don't have to. These questions are merely a formality for our race.

44.Text: Ranger <Player>, did you have an appointment or is this a walk-in? I've had it with these fat-faced maloqs, always loitering about and asking for stuff... What do you need now?

Text: Dear human <Player>! We are glad to see the human race follow the path of progress.

The doors of our spaceport are always open to you. You're probably interested in alcohol, am I right?? No need to blush now -- we are well aware of the needs of your people. The goods are completely legal and priced at <CurPlanetGoodsSale> cr per unit. Enjoy!

46.Text: Dear <Player>, thank you for landing on our planet. It's not everyday that we get a chance to see a straight arrow ranger, and a representative of such an ancient race at that. We have always had all the respect for the gaal people. They say that you are becoming extinct though, is this true?

Text: Most esteemed <Player>! It is a great honor for us to see you here. Our government is doing everything in its power to draw distinguished rangers like yourself to visit us.
And though you may not have earned a high military rank just yet, we have all the faith in the world in you!
Oh, by the way, do visit our store. We have prepared a shipment of medical supplies especially for you. No less than <CurPlanetGoodsCnt> units of the highest quality merchandise.
Dear <Player>, we are glad to welcome you to our planet. What brings you here? Are you looking to rest after a long voyage or take on a new mission?
Or maybe go on a shopping spree? Whatever the case, please make yourself at home!

Ranger <Player>!  So glad you dropped by. You've probably been bouncing in space for a while; have you heard of the latest developments in the <ToStar> system? I can see by your face that you don't. We pelengs have been keeping tabs on this captured system, but abstained from intervention to avoid any misunderstandings. You understand what I mean by that, don't you?

Now I'd like to talk about a wonderful product made from dried swamp plants on one of the planets in the <ToStar> system. Back in the day we used to organize dru... Excuse me, business tours there, but the dominator invasion has put an end to all that. Now all we can do is wait until you rangers drive those stupid tin cans from this holy place.

Greetings, !
According to our sources, planet is currently experiencing a food shortage. Their reserves are eviscerated, so prices are inflated accordingly.
<Player>, you can earn a whole lot of money by delivering our goods to the <ToStar> system. But you must hurry -- as of today we have <CurPlanetGoodsCnt> units in our storage.
Yo! Pirate <Player>!  It is good to see other pirates not forgetting their peleng brethren!

Our sources have just informed us that a bunch of fat cats are due to arrive to one of the resort planets i the <ToStar> system. And you know how much pirates like fat cats... But watch yourself if you plan on going to the dance: you're not the first or the only one with this information.

Dear <Player>! Did you hear the news? It's common knowledge that our neighbors over at planet <ToPlanet> are run by a monarchy. Needless to say, we feel sorry for the common folk, deprived of the right to choose their leaders democratically.

Their monarch also resists all technological progress on the argument that it "kills the soul." This explains the inflated prices for all manner of tech -- a fact taken full advantage of by a number of business-minded individuals.

52.Text: Ranger <Player>! Our planet is undergoing yet another regime change, leaving us without stable government at this time. This means you can purchase goods that are banned on other planets, such as grade A narcotics at rock-bottom prices.

Text: <Player>, the state of martial law declared in our system has caused many of our planet's residents to take up arms. Even civilians are gearing up to fight back the aggressors!
Today we're buying up weapons at astronomical prices. So if you've got anything to sell, you'll turn a good profit. And then, we shall ride to battle together. Let us crush the dominator scum!
Parade, fireworks, military demonstrations! Ranger <Player>, today we celebrate the traditional maloq holiday of Seven Explosions.
Don't bother asking me a thousand questions. You aliens will never understand it.
Ranger <Player>, today we celebrate the traditional maloq holiday called The Iron Grip. There'll be a military parade, fireworks and fisticuffs in the streets!
Don't bother asking me a thousand questions. You aliens will never understand it. But if you insist, you can join the festivities as a target dummy. In fact, we'd be much obliged if you do.

This is the Great Gorge, <Player>! Another traditional maloq holiday. Today we will witness a military parade of our hardiest and "girthiest" soldiers, a sutro stone wrestling match, and a display of fireworks celebrating the grand maloq civilization!
Aliens like you are advised from going outside at all. Folks will be gorging themselves today, as per tradition. We don't want to set any unfortunate precedents. Thanks in advance.

57.Text: Ranger <Player>! It is an honor to welcome such a great warrior on our humble planet. If you pay a visit our shops, we will be telling our grandkids about this day.

Text: Businessmen are quite fond of our planet, and our esteemed merchant <Player> is proof of that! The gods must have heard our prayers!

Our planet has been exporting foodstuffs for many years now. All of our products are made from top-of-the-line mud extracted from planet <CurPlanet>'s most putrid lakes. Accordingly, prices aren't cheap, for this isn't a problem for faeyans or other rich folk. We've prepared an exclusive deal for you at our trade center: truly delectable nagout from fraisies and shmacon at wholesale prices! I trust a seasoned entrepreneur such as yourself will recognize a deal when he sees one.

How in earth did you end up here, <Player>? We have been waging fierce battles against the dominators. Civilians have been fleeing the system, selling off whatever possessions they can. Prices for luxury goods have hit rock bottom!
Help us defend the <CurStar> system!
According to our data, planet <ToPlanet> is experiencing a shortage of medical supplies. The local population is suffering from diseases, and we certainly sympathize.
<Player>, you can make good money by taking your medical supplies to the <ToStar> system. But hurry before more resourceful rangers beat you to it.
Do my eyes deceive me, <Player>?! A maloq trader, may the dominators take me! I've never expected this from a fellow maloq. Let alone a ranger.

You're a disgrace to your race of great warriors and conquerors of galaxies! Did you ever consider how your mother, class III grand sapper of the 157th assault regiment, must have felt when she found out you became a filthy huckster?
Grow up and join the fight -- the Galaxy is still teeming with dominators! And forget about this silly trading business -- that's only for crooks, cowards and humans.
What are you doing here, Ranger <Player>?!!
This isn't the time to conduct scientific research or ask us for missions. Refuel, repair -- do whatever it is you have to do -- and get back out there! The dominators must be driven from our system!
Don't even try arguing with me, 'cause my brain lobes will explode right before your eyes! And trust me -- that's not something you want to see.
People have been flooding into our system to help their brothers repulse the enemy. Thank you for coming as well, <Player>.
Now please hurry -- we need you out there on the orbit of planet <CurPlanet>, rather than on its surface.
Ranger <Player>, you've picked the worst time to visit our planet. Our system is in danger -- the dominators are continuing their offensive with renewed vigor.
The situation clearly exposes the conflict between dominators and gaals. Remember, our goal is to achieve a peaceful solution to this conflict.

We have lived in this world for so long that we've lost sight of the goal. And what is the goal of every gaal? That's right, there is no goal! There is only substance, and substance cannot be found in hustle and vanity...
Are you just going to keep talking smack, <Player>? You could easily assemble a fleet and blast those haughty faeyans at their base. I know that you maloqs don't like their kind.
So why don't you buy a shipment of weapons from us? Top quality stuff, this is! And lots of it too, just like you maloqs like -- as many as <CurPlanetGoodsCnt> units!
You are one unlucky SOB to have been born a gaal, <Player>. Were you this ugly from birth or did you need special surgery?

Oh, did I offend you? These aren't my words -- it's what faeyans and humans say about your people. I'm just giving it to you straight. Who else would you trust to tell you the truth if not us pelengs? That's what I thought.

So, uh, seeing as how life is hard and all, you wanna buy some herb? Very gooood! We've got <CurPlanetGoodsCnt> units' worth of the stuff in storage -- and a special price just for you! Out of our great esteem for the gaalian race!
"A man is as good as his wurd!" I'm talking about you, <Player>! Did that surprise you? Of course it did! I know a whole lot of human proverbs!

Here's another one, "Do you feel lucky, poonk? Well, do ya?!" Whew, that sounds awesome! I always thought that "poonk" was a type of maloq -- a stupid and disobedient creature. Plus, maloqs always think that they're so lucky. Except for all their luck they're still totally broke. That's because we gave them fae-made ATMs that charge a 50% service fee from all transactions. But maloqs figured that's just how it should be, so now they're paying double for everything. Not that you humans are concerned about maloqs, what with those haughty faeyans and prissy gaals standing in your way. Our two races should join forces! We propose forming an alliance immediately after the war!

Ah, <Player>, wonderful. The fae have declared an embargo against us. And all because we were supplying them with a harmless herb... Umm... We would prefer not to break any laws, but as a creature of another race, it shouldn't be a burden for you to do us a small favor. So, are you looking to make some money? Then listen up!

The faeyan <ToPlanet> is in dire need of our merchandise. Here all the transactions are totally legal. So buy whatever you want, then deliver and unload. Buy it from us at <CurPlanetGoodsSale> cr, then sell it to them at <ToPlanetGoodsBuy> cr! See the difference? You won't find a better bargain anywhere else!

<Player>, this must be fate. Do you play paratroopers? The game is pretty popular in our circles. It takes two volunteers -- one peleng and one alien, like yourself -- who put on a special uniform and go on to commit five unintentional crimes. Of course, the regular folk will try to kill you, seeking to stop your acts of violence and vandalism. Your reward is whatever you manage to steal or rob, even if it's Supreme Lyakusha's favorite bunny slipper! And whoever ends up with more loot is killed by the one with less. Sounds fun, doesn't it?!
So, shall we begin?

You don't want to play?... That just won't do, mister! Then I will keep bugging you until you agree to buy a small batch of luxury goods from us. Currently we have <CurPlanetGoodsCnt> units in the storage, so get to it!

Man, I've got a headache from playing video games. I'm sick and tired of those stupid four-arm controllers! They're enough to make a hardcore gamer want to quit... Hey, don't you see what I'm getting at here?!! An ocean of excellent controllers, mnemonic CDs and other junk that all resourceful businessmen need!

I'll be back with a wholesale price list. Right, so we have <CurPlanetGoodsCnt> units of first-rate merchandise priced at just <CurPlanetGoodsSale> cr! <Player>, it's your destiny to make this purchase! Hurry to our trade center!

7.Text: Did you forget something, <Player>? You are not allowed to conduct business on our planet. This is a problem for you, because normally we're willing to buy up minerals at any price. But we won't buy any from you on principle.

70.Text: <Player>, you are absolutely not the person I want to see in my office. You are therefore prohibited from conducting any commercial dealings on this planet.

71.Text: <Player>, did you lose something? I can't say that your appearance evokes positive emotions in me. Quite the opposite, actually.

72.Text: How wonderful that you dropped by, <Player>! I'm so happy! What can I do for you? Go on, I'm all ears.

73.Text: Always glad to see you, <Player>! Would you like a few shots of tokilla or a secret mission? Or maybe both, he-he?

74.Text: What the hell are you doing on our planet, <Player>? Get lost before I call my underlings and have them break your thick alien skull!

75.Text: Greetings, <Player>! It's always great seeing a familiar mug here on planet <CurPlanet>.

76.Text:
Well, well, Ranger . Your stripe tells me that you're not terribly good at performing your ranger duties. That's a good thing around here -- we don't much like zealous upstarts that blindly follow the Coalition.
If ever you become one, you had better avoid coming here. But if you become a pirate instead, you'll get all the respect from us.

77.Text:
You should know, , that we're not too fond of pirates! You're like a spoon of spicy maloq sauce in a barrel of sweet nectar.
Har-har-har, I'm just kidding! I love pirates, you guys crack me up! Banditry, contraband... it's so romantic! If not for this wonderful post of mine, where I sit and do nothing all day, I'd join the pirates myself.

Text: Welcome, <Player>. Pirates are always welcome on our planet. You may be an alien, but we won't hold it against you. So feel free to stay a while, see the sights, check out the market...
We will ask one favor of you, and that's to buy a batch of tech on our planet. We've had difficulties attracting customers... :-(

79.Text: And what exactly brings a filthy four-armed peleng like <Player> to our prospering planet? Surely he's here to mouse out our plans and sell them to the Coalition?

8.Text: Ranger <Player>, our compatriot! It's always great seeing you here on planet <CurPlanet>.

80.Text: If it isn't eminent Ranger <Player> in the flesh! We don't take kindly to your kind around here! 'Course, we can't be kicking all visiting rangers off the planet, that's just bad for business. But you'd be wise to watch your back while you're here, lest some young and eager pirate try to prove himself by cracking open your skull. If that were to happen, he won't be convicted in court -- you can trust me on that. So why don't you leave for the <ToStar> system to shoot up dominators with your army buddies? You boys live for that stuff, don't you?

81.Text: The <ToStar> system was invaded by dominators. Now, we couldn't give a hoot about those losers, but if the dominators secure a foothold there, their next target will be this planet, and an invasion of those tin cans is very bad for business. We must therefore ask you to help us avert this potential threat from our system's borders, <Player>.

Text: As we speak, vicious and bloody battles against the dominators are unfolding in the <ToStar> system. And you, <Player>, are in a position to help your race big time, assuming you can be bothered with such work.

And should your sense of ranger duty finally awaken, you can bring along a batch of meds, which you can also buy right here on our planet. As you can see, we care not only about others' interests, but ours as well!

83.Text: <Player>, all the top rangers have gathered in the <ToStar> system, fighting alongside your compatriots, trying to recapture it from the dominators and dying in bunches in bloody combat. And all the top pirates are living it up, counting their money without a care in the world. So you tell me, who's smarter?

Text: Greetings, <Player>! You hold a position somewhere at the very end of the ranger list, and that's commendable. It doesn't pay to dance to the Coalition's tune, running their stupid errands. We pirates don't have any silly rating system, and we're perfectly fine with that. By the way, it seems that you're a wanted criminal on planet <ToPlanet>... Impressive!
Keep up the good work and you'll soon be basking in well-earned glory in our pirate community!
Howdy, Ranger <Player>! You are a fine ranger, and that's no compliment coming from us. You get our drift?

By the way, a message recently came in from the <ToStar> system; apparently, they're looking to throw you in prison. Unfortunately, we lack the resources to extradite you there ourselves, to thank your lucky stars. If you ask me, all rangers ought to spend some time in the slammer, if only to feel what it's like to be degraded.

Ah, Ranger <Player>, there you are! Did you know that our neighbors from planet <ToPlanet> are demanding your immediate extradition? We don't intend to grant you asylum, so the problem is yours to deal with.
By the way, they plan on meeting you on the orbit, so we recommend stocking up on powerful cannons from our shop. It would be a shame if you died with all that unspent cash in your pockets...

87.Text: Welcome to our wonderful planet <CurPlanet>, human. We must note that you really ought to lead a more pirate-friendly lifestyle. You have a low ranger rating, but it would be better if you had none at all. Keep that in mind for the future.

88.Text: Dear <Player>, thank you for landing on our planet. It's not everyday that we get a chance to see a straight arrow ranger, and a representative of such an ancient race at that. Though, to be perfectly frank, it would be great if all the rangers of all races died a horrible, painful death right this instant. With all due respect, of course.

Text: <Player>, your ranger rating is inexorably rising! If you don't cut it out at once, we'll have no choice but to sever our relationship for good! You should engage in pirate activities instead.
Oh, by the way, do visit our store. We have prepared a shipment of medical supplies especially for you. No less than <CurPlanetGoodsCnt> units of the highest quality merchandise.

9.Text:
Oh, Ranger ! Do come in! Your stripe tells me you are not making life easy for the dominators. Let's verify this information with the ranger center...
Let's see now... There's not much here...
, why don't you turn in nodes to them? They're complaining about you. And your rating is way low, which is just sad! Pick up your game, slacker!

90.Text: Always happy to see a great warrior like yourself, <Player>. Now, if only you had the brains to ditch all that endless dominator fighting in favor of a legendary pirate career, but whatever floats your boat. You can even leave me your photograph so that I could tell my grandkids about the time I enlightened you about missed career opportunities.

Text: What are you doing here, Ranger <Player>?!!
This isn't the time to conduct scientific research or ask us for missions. Refuel, repair -- do whatever it is you have to do -- and get back out there! The Dominators are invading the system!
Don't even try arguing with me, 'cause my brain lobes will explode right before your eyes! And trust me -- that's not something you want to see.
Unfortunately, even pirates aren't insured against dominator attacks, <Player>. This is one such incident.
Now please hurry and take off -- we need you out there on the orbit of planet <CurPlanet>, rather than on its surface.

93.Text:
While you're sitting pretty planetside, others are battling pirates on the orbit! How do you justify your behavior, ?!!
Or are you secretly supporting those bastards? If that's the case, shame on you!

94.Text: <Player>, we are not happy to see you one bit, 'cause you're a no-good, miserable humanoid. We therefore forbid you from doing business on this planet. And thank your lucky stars I didn't call my crew to give you our signature "hard" welcome.

95.Text: While you're screwing around here, <Player>, our outer lines of defense are under attack. Now get your ass to the cockpit and join the free pirates in the fight for our independence.

Text: Oh, hey, buddy. Me and the boys were just celebrating... Err, whatchamacallit...
Never mind, listen to this joke I heard. A gaal merchant comes to a peleng planet. A customs officer meets him in the port and says... Wait, what did he say...
Something is up with my memory, clearly. I think I'm going to stuff telling you stuff... Oh, did you already tell me what you wanted?

97.Text: <Player>, pirates have been running the show here of late, so keep your ear to the ground, assuming your physiology allows it. Just yesterday I had my wallet stolen, and it took me three friggin' hours before I could return the favor to some other sucker. I was cold, tired and sleep-deprived just as my shift started. So bear it in mind.

98.Text: This planet is controlled by dom... Bah, there I go again, misspeaking. It's the pirates who are running things around here, <Player>, and don't you forget it. We've got our own rules, meaning there aren't any. Anyone can be shot at any time. This is a new step in the evolution of society, and before you start arguing this point, note that I have a loaded blaster in my desk drawer. So I suggest you move away from your soapbox and tell me what you're here for.

Text: Howdy, <Player>! I was just telling my boys that gaals make the best pirates on account of their weird perception of reality. What about you -- do you think that gaals are more or less dangerous than maloqs? Is one gaal pirate more dangerous two maloqs? And what if the gaal's shield generator is on the fritz and one of the maloq ships is very lightly armored? You don't have to answer if you don't want to. I was just curious, but I don't really give a hoot either way.
What did you want again?
